`,mO=`
${XC}
uniform float uTime;
uniform float uCloudCoverage;
uniform vec2 uCloudOffset;
uniform float uSunDiskIntensity;
varying vec3 vSkyDir;

float skyHash( vec2 p ) {
  vec3 p3 = fract( vec3( p.xyx ) * 0.1031 );
  p3 += dot( p3, p3.yzx + 33.33 );
  return fract( ( p3.x + p3.y ) * p3.z );
}

float skyNoise( vec2 p ) {
  vec2 i = floor( p );
  vec2 f = fract( p );
  vec2 u = f * f * ( 3.0 - 2.0 * f );
  float a = skyHash( i );
  float b = skyHash( i + vec2( 1.0, 0.0 ) );
  float c = skyHash( i + vec2( 0.0, 1.0 ) );
  float d = skyHash( i + vec2( 1.0, 1.0 ) );
  return mix( mix( a, b, u.x ), mix( c, d, u.x ), u.y );
}

const mat2 SKY_ROT = mat2( 0.8, -0.6, 0.6, 0.8 );

float skyFbm( vec2 p, int octaves ) {
  float sum = 0.0;
  float amp = 0.5;
  for ( int i = 0; i < 6; i++ ) {
    if ( i >= octaves ) break;
    sum += amp * skyNoise( p );
    p = SKY_ROT * p * 2.03 + 17.1;
    amp *= 0.5;
  }
  return sum;
}

// Billowy cumulus density in [0, 1].
float cloudDensity( vec2 p, int octaves ) {
  vec2 warp = vec2( skyFbm( p * 0.45 + 3.7, 3 ), skyFbm( p * 0.45 - 5.1, 3 ) );
  float n = skyFbm( p + warp * 1.1, octaves );
  float base = skyFbm( p * 0.22 + 9.0, 2 );
  n = n * 0.75 + base * 0.45;
  float threshold = 1.02 - uCloudCoverage;
  return smoothstep( threshold, threshold + 0.2, n );
}

void main() {
  vec3 dir = normalize( vSkyDir );
  vec3 col = atmosphereSky( dir );

  float mu = dot( dir, uSunDirection );
  float disk = smoothstep( 0.99988, 0.99994, mu );
  col += uSunColor * disk * uSunDiskIntensity;

  if ( dir.y > 0.0 ) {
    vec2 p = dir.xz / ( dir.y + 0.09 ) * 0.55 + uCloudOffset;
    float d = cloudDensity( p, 6 );
    if ( d > 0.001 ) {
      vec2 toSun = normalize( uSunDirection.xz + vec2( 1e-4 ) );
      float dSun = cloudDensity( p + toSun * 0.09, 4 );
      float lit = clamp( 0.62 + ( d - dSun ) * 1.6, 0.0, 1.0 );
      vec3 bright = uSunColor * 1.05 + uZenithColor * 0.18;
      vec3 shade = mix( uHorizonColor, uZenithColor, 0.35 ) * 0.62 + vec3( 0.05 );
      vec3 cloud = mix( shade, bright, lit * ( 1.0 - d * 0.28 ) );
      float sunFwd = pow( max( mu, 0.0 ), 10.0 );
      cloud += uSunColor * sunFwd * ( 1.0 - d ) * 1.2;
      float horizonFade = smoothstep( 0.015, 0.2, dir.y );
      // Distant clouds sink into the horizon haze.
      cloud = mix( atmosphereSky( dir ), cloud, smoothstep( 0.0, 0.35, dir.y ) * 0.55 + 0.45 );
      col = mix( col, cloud, d * horizonFade * 0.96 );
    }
  }
  gl_FragColor = vec4( col, 1.0 );
  #include <tonemapping_fragment>
  #include <colorspace_fragment>
}

 float desertRock=clamp((1.0-abs(vDesertNormal.y))*2.6+smoothstep(.48,.73,desertMacro)*.66,0.0,.92);

 `),r.fragmentShader=H_(r.fragmentShader,`#include <roughnessmap_fragment>`,`roughnessFactor=mix(texture2D(uDesertRough,desertUV).g,.89,desertRock);`),r.fragmentShader=H_(r.fragmentShader,`#include <normal_fragment_maps>`,`
 vec3 desertDetail=texture2D(uDesertNormal,desertUV).xyz*2.0-1.0;float desertFade=1.0-smoothstep(25.0,160.0,desertDistance);

 `)}}function yO(e,t){return n=>{n.uniforms.uGrimeMap=e,t&&(n.vertexShader=`#define FACADE_WORLD_UV\n${n.vertexShader}`,n.fragmentShader=`#define FACADE_WORLD_UV\n${n.fragmentShader}`),n.vertexShader=V_(n.vertexShader,`void main() {`,`
      attribute vec4 aFacadeA;
      attribute vec4 aFacadeB;
      attribute vec3 aGlass;
      attribute vec3 aFrame;
      attribute float aGround;
      #ifndef FACADE_WORLD_UV
      attribute vec2 aFacadeUV;
      #endif
      varying vec2 vFacadeUV;
      varying vec4 vFacadeA;
      varying vec4 vFacadeB;
      varying vec3 vGlass;
      varying vec3 vFrame;
      varying float vGround;
      varying vec3 vFacadeNormalW;
      `),n.vertexShader=H_(n.vertexShader,`#include <begin_vertex>`,`
      vFacadeA = aFacadeA;
      vFacadeB = aFacadeB;
      vGlass = aGlass;
      vFrame = aFrame;
      vGround = aGround;
      #ifdef FACADE_WORLD_UV
        vec4 facadeWP = modelMatrix * instanceMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );
        vec3 facadeWN = normalize( mat3( modelMatrix ) * mat3( instanceMatrix ) * normal );
        vFacadeUV = vec2( dot( facadeWP.xz, vec2( -facadeWN.z, facadeWN.x ) ), facadeWP.y );
        vFacadeNormalW = facadeWN;
      #else
        vFacadeUV = aFacadeUV;
        vFacadeNormalW = normalize( mat3( modelMatrix ) * normal );
      #endif
      `),n.fragmentShader=V_(n.fragmentShader,`void main() {`,`
      uniform sampler2D uGrimeMap;
      varying vec2 vFacadeUV;
      varying vec4 vFacadeA;
      varying vec4 vFacadeB;
      varying vec3 vGlass;
      varying vec3 vFrame;
      varying float vGround;
      varying vec3 vFacadeNormalW;
      float facadeHash( vec2 p ) {
        vec3 p3 = fract( vec3( p.xyx ) * 0.1031 );
        p3 += dot( p3, p3.yzx + 33.33 );
        return fract( ( p3.x + p3.y ) * p3.z );
      }
      `),n.fragmentShader=H_(n.fragmentShader,`#include <color_fragment>`,`
      vec2 fUV = vFacadeUV;
      float floorH = vFacadeA.x;
      float bayW = vFacadeA.y;
      float groundH = vFacadeA.z;
      float topH = vFacadeA.w;
      float fStyle = vFacadeB.x;
      float fSeed = floor( vFacadeB.w * 1024.0 + 0.5 ) / 1024.0;
      float facadeGlass = 0.0;
      vec3 facadeInterior = vec3( 0.0 );
      vec2 facadeTilt = vec2( 0.0 );
      vec3 wallCol = diffuseColor.rgb;
      vec4 grimeA = texture2D( uGrimeMap, fUV * vec2( 0.045, 0.03 ) + fSeed * 0.37 );
      vec4 grimeB = texture2D( uGrimeMap, fUV * vec2( 0.3, 0.018 ) + fSeed * 0.71 );
      wallCol *= mix( 0.92, 1.04, grimeA.r ) * mix( 0.95, 1.025, grimeB.g );
      wallCol *= mix( 0.66, 1.0, smoothstep( 0.0, 1.8, fUV.y ) );
      float pxPerM = 1.0 / max( max( fwidth( fUV.x ), fwidth( fUV.y ) ), 1e-4 );
      float aa = 0.8 / pxPerM;

      if ( fStyle > 3.5 && fStyle < 4.5 ) {
        // Brick running bond, faded out once bricks get smaller than a few pixels.
        vec2 b = fUV / vec2( 0.25, 0.08 );
        float row = floor( b.y );
        b.x += mod( row, 2.0 ) * 0.5;
        vec2 bf = fract( b );
        float brickDetail = smoothstep( 2.0, 5.0, 0.08 * pxPerM );
        float mortar = max( 1.0 - smoothstep( 0.0, 0.07, bf.y ), 1.0 - smoothstep( 0.0, 0.035, min( bf.x, 1.0 - bf.x ) ) );
        float brickTone = mix( 0.82, 1.12, facadeHash( floor( b ) + fSeed ) );
        vec3 brickCol = mix( wallCol * brickTone, vec3( 0.42, 0.4, 0.37 ), mortar * 0.8 );
        wallCol = mix( wallCol, brickCol, brickDetail );
      }

      float h1 = 0.5;
      if ( fStyle > 0.5 && fUV.y < topH ) {
        bool inGround = fUV.y < groundH;
        float cellW = bayW;
        float cellH = floorH;
        float wW = vFacadeB.y;
        float wH = vFacadeB.z;
        float sill = ( 1.0 - wH ) * 0.42;
        vec2 cell = vec2( fUV.x / bayW, ( fUV.y - groundH ) / floorH );
        if ( inGround ) {
          cellH = groundH;
          if ( vGround > 1.5 ) {
            cellW = 1.7; wW = 0.94; wH = 0.84; sill = 0.02;
          } else if ( vGround > 0.5 ) {
            wW = 0.88; wH = 0.64; sill = 0.1;
          } else {
            wH = wH * 0.8; sill = 0.26;
          }
          cell = vec2( fUV.x / cellW, fUV.y / cellH );
        }
        vec2 cellId = floor( cell );
        vec2 c = fract( cell );
        vec2 pM = c * vec2( cellW, cellH );
        vec2 halfM = vec2( wW * cellW, wH * cellH ) * 0.5;
        vec2 centerM = vec2( 0.5 * cellW, ( sill + wH * 0.5 ) * cellH );
        vec2 dM = abs( pM - centerM ) - halfM;
        float boxD = max( dM.x, dM.y );
        float frameW = fStyle > 2.5 && fStyle < 3.5 ? 0.045 : ( inGround ? 0.09 : 0.07 );
        float detail = smoothstep( 2.5, 7.0, min( cellW, cellH ) * pxPerM );
        float cover = wW * wH;
        float winMask = mix( cover, 1.0 - smoothstep( -aa, aa, boxD ), detail );
        float glassMask = mix( cover * 0.86, 1.0 - smoothstep( -aa, aa, boxD + frameW ), detail );

        h1 = facadeHash( cellId + fSeed * 13.1 );
        float h2 = facadeHash( cellId.yx * 1.37 + fSeed * 7.7 );
        vec3 glass = vGlass * mix( 0.6, 1.3, h1 );
        float wy = clamp( ( pM.y - ( centerM.y - halfM.y ) ) / max( 2.0 * halfM.y, 1e-3 ), 0.0, 1.0 );
        float blinds = step( 0.68, h2 ) * step( 1.0 - fract( h2 * 7.31 ) * 0.85, wy );
        float blindAmt = fStyle > 2.5 && fStyle < 3.5 ? 0.25 : 0.85;
        glass = mix( glass, vec3( 0.46, 0.43, 0.38 ) * ( 0.75 + 0.45 * h1 ), blinds * detail * blindAmt );
        float reveal = smoothstep( 0.0, 0.18, -( boxD + frameW ) );
        glass *= mix( 1.0, mix( 0.5, 1.0, reveal ), detail );
        if ( inGround && vGround > 0.5 ) {
          glass = mix( glass, vec3( 0.07, 0.06, 0.05 ) * ( 0.7 + h1 * 0.8 ), 0.55 );
          // Lit shop interior seen through the glass: ceiling light, shelf bands, per-unit tint.
          float shelf = 0.62 + 0.38 * step( 0.45, fract( wy * 3.5 + h2 ) );
          float ceiling = smoothstep( 0.45, 1.0, wy );
          vec3 warm = mix( vec3( 1.0, 0.8, 0.58 ), vec3( 0.86, 0.93, 1.0 ), step( 0.62, h1 ) );
          facadeInterior = warm * ( 0.05 + ceiling * 0.16 ) * shelf * ( 0.55 + h2 * 0.9 );
        }

        vec3 col = wallCol;
        float sillMask = 0.0;
        if ( !inGround && ( fStyle < 1.5 || ( fStyle > 3.5 && fStyle < 4.5 ) ) ) {
          vec2 sd = vec2( abs( pM.x - centerM.x ) - ( halfM.x + 0.07 ), abs( pM.y - ( centerM.y - halfM.y - 0.06 ) ) - 0.06 );
          sillMask = ( 1.0 - smoothstep( -aa, aa, max( sd.x, sd.y ) ) ) * detail;
          // Rain streaks below sills.
          float below = centerM.y - halfM.y - pM.y;
          float streak = step( abs( pM.x - centerM.x ), halfM.x * 0.9 ) * smoothstep( 1.2, 0.0, below ) * step( 0.0, below );
          col *= 1.0 - streak * grimeB.b * 0.18 * detail;
        }
        if ( fStyle > 1.5 && fStyle < 2.5 ) {
          // Floor slab line on ribbon-window facades.
          float slab = 1.0 - smoothstep( 0.0, 0.08 + aa, abs( pM.y - cellH ) );
          col *= 1.0 - slab * 0.25 * detail;
        }
        col = mix( col, vFrame, clamp( winMask - glassMask, 0.0, 1.0 ) );
        col = mix( col, vFrame * 1.08, sillMask );
        col = mix( col, glass, glassMask );
        wallCol = col;
        facadeGlass = glassMask;
        facadeInterior *= glassMask * detail;
        facadeTilt = ( vec2( h1, h2 ) - 0.5 ) * 0.07 * detail;
      }
      diffuseColor.rgb = wallCol;
      `),n.fragmentShader=H_(n.fragmentShader,`#include <roughnessmap_fragment>`,`roughnessFactor = mix( 0.86 + grimeA.g * 0.1, 0.05 + 0.07 * h1, facadeGlass );`),n.fragmentShader=H_(n.fragmentShader,`#include <emissivemap_fragment>`,`totalEmissiveRadiance += facadeInterior;`),n.fragmentShader=H_(n.fragmentShader,`#include <normal_fragment_maps>`,`
      if ( facadeGlass > 0.001 ) {

        normal = normalize( ( viewMatrix * vec4( nP, 0.0 ) ).xyz );
      }
      `),n.fragmentShader=H_(n.fragmentShader,`#include <lights_physical_fragment>`,`
      material.specularColor = mix( material.specularColor, vec3( 0.055 ), facadeGlass );
      material.specularColorBlended = mix( material.specularColorBlended, vec3( 0.055 ), facadeGlass );
      `),n.fragmentShader=V_(n.fragmentShader,`#include <lights_fragment_end>`,`
      #if defined( RE_IndirectSpecular )
      {
        // Windows mostly reflect the street and buildings opposite, not open sky.
        vec3 reflW = inverseTransformDirection( reflect( -geometryViewDir, geometryNormal ), viewMatrix );
        float horizonOcclusion = mix( 0.28, 1.0, smoothstep( -0.05, 0.45, reflW.y ) );
        radiance *= mix( 1.0, horizonOcclusion, facadeGlass );
      }
      #endif
      `)}}function bO(e){return t=>{t.uniforms.uTime=e.uTime,t.uniforms.uWindStrength=e.uWindStrength,t.vertexShader=V_(t.vertexShader,`void main() {`,`attribute float aWind;

      {
        vec3 instOrigin = vec3( 0.0 );

          instOrigin = instanceMatrix[ 3 ].xyz;
        #endif

      }

varying vec2 vUv;
void main() {
  vUv = uv;
  gl_Position = vec4( position.xy, 0.0, 1.0 );

`,zO=`
uniform sampler2D tSource;
uniform vec2 uTexel;
uniform float uPrefilter;
uniform float uThreshold;
uniform float uKnee;
varying vec2 vUv;

vec3 sampleTap( vec2 uv ) { return texture2D( tSource, uv ).rgb; }

vec3 prefilter( vec3 c ) {
  float brightness = max( c.r, max( c.g, c.b ) );
  float soft = clamp( brightness - uThreshold + uKnee, 0.0, 2.0 * uKnee );
  soft = soft * soft / ( 4.0 * uKnee + 1e-4 );
  float contribution = max( soft, brightness - uThreshold ) / max( brightness, 1e-4 );
  return c * contribution;
}

float karis( vec3 c ) { return 1.0 / ( 1.0 + max( c.r, max( c.g, c.b ) ) ); }

void main() {
  vec2 t = uTexel;
  vec3 a = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( -2.0, 2.0 ) );
  vec3 b = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( 0.0, 2.0 ) );
  vec3 c = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( 2.0, 2.0 ) );
  vec3 d = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( -2.0, 0.0 ) );
  vec3 e = sampleTap( vUv );
  vec3 f = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( 2.0, 0.0 ) );
  vec3 g = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( -2.0, -2.0 ) );
  vec3 h = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( 0.0, -2.0 ) );
  vec3 i = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( 2.0, -2.0 ) );
  vec3 j = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( -1.0, 1.0 ) );
  vec3 k = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( 1.0, 1.0 ) );
  vec3 l = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( -1.0, -1.0 ) );
  vec3 m = sampleTap( vUv + t * vec2( 1.0, -1.0 ) );
  vec3 result;
  if ( uPrefilter > 0.5 ) {
    // Karis average on the first mip suppresses sparkling highlights ("fireflies").
    vec3 g0 = ( a + b + d + e ) * 0.25;
    vec3 g1 = ( b + c + e + f ) * 0.25;
    vec3 g2 = ( d + e + g + h ) * 0.25;
    vec3 g3 = ( e + f + h + i ) * 0.25;
    vec3 g4 = ( j + k + l + m ) * 0.25;
    float w0 = karis( g0 ) * 0.125;
    float w1 = karis( g1 ) * 0.125;
    float w2 = karis( g2 ) * 0.125;
    float w3 = karis( g3 ) * 0.125;
    float w4 = karis( g4 ) * 0.5;
    result = ( g0 * w0 + g1 * w1 + g2 * w2 + g3 * w3 + g4 * w4 ) / ( w0 + w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 );
    result = prefilter( result );
  } else {
    result = e * 0.125 + ( a + c + g + i ) * 0.03125 + ( b + d + f + h ) * 0.0625 + ( j + k + l + m ) * 0.125;
  }
  gl_FragColor = vec4( max( result, vec3( 0.0 ) ), 1.0 );
}
`,BO=`

`,VO=`
uniform sampler2D tScene;
uniform sampler2D tBloom;
uniform float uBloomStrength;
uniform float uExposure;
uniform vec3 uWhiteBalance;
uniform float uSaturation;
uniform float uContrast;
uniform vec3 uShadowTint;
uniform vec3 uHighlightTint;
uniform float uVignette;
uniform float uTime;
uniform vec2 uResolution;
varying vec2 vUv;

// ACES fitted (Stephen Hill).
const mat3 ACES_IN = mat3( 0.59719, 0.07600, 0.02840, 0.35458, 0.90834, 0.13383, 0.04823, 0.01566, 0.83777 );
const mat3 ACES_OUT = mat3( 1.60475, -0.10208, -0.00327, -0.53108, 1.10813, -0.07276, -0.07367, -0.00605, 1.07602 );
vec3 rrtOdt( vec3 v ) {
  vec3 a = v * ( v + 0.0245786 ) - 0.000090537;
  vec3 b = v * ( 0.983729 * v + 0.4329510 ) + 0.238081;
  return a / b;
}
vec3 acesFitted( vec3 c ) {
  c = ACES_IN * c;
  c = rrtOdt( c );
  return clamp( ACES_OUT * c, 0.0, 1.0 );
}
vec3 linearToSrgb( vec3 c ) {
  vec3 lo = c * 12.92;
  vec3 hi = 1.055 * pow( c, vec3( 1.0 / 2.4 ) ) - 0.055;
  return mix( lo, hi, step( vec3( 0.0031308 ), c ) );
}
float hash( vec2 p ) {
  vec3 p3 = fract( vec3( p.xyx ) * 0.1031 );
  p3 += dot( p3, p3.yzx + 33.33 );
  return fract( ( p3.x + p3.y ) * p3.z );
}

void main() {
  vec3 hdr = texture2D( tScene, vUv ).rgb;
  hdr += texture2D( tBloom, vUv ).rgb * uBloomStrength;
  hdr *= uExposure * uWhiteBalance;

  vec3 c = acesFitted( hdr );
  float luma = dot( c, vec3( 0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722 ) );
  c = max( mix( vec3( luma ), c, uSaturation ), 0.0 );
  // Split toning: cool shadows, warm highlights.
  float hl = smoothstep( 0.25, 0.9, luma );
  c *= mix( uShadowTint, uHighlightTint, hl );

  vec3 s = linearToSrgb( clamp( c, 0.0, 1.0 ) );
  s = mix( s, s * s * ( 3.0 - 2.0 * s ), uContrast );

  vec2 v = ( vUv - 0.5 ) * vec2( uResolution.x / uResolution.y, 1.0 );
  float vig = 1.0 - smoothstep( 0.45, 1.25, length( v ) ) * uVignette;
  s *= vig;

  s += ( hash( vUv * uResolution + fract( uTime ) * 61.0 ) - 0.5 ) / 255.0 * 0.65;
  gl_FragColor = vec4( s, 1.0 );
}
